helpBury: b <idx x8>                bury eight cards back into the kitty
helpPlay: p <idx...>                play (e.g. p 0 1 for a pair)
header: Hand {{hand}} / level: {{level}} / trump: {{trump}} / declarers: team {{declarer}} / team 0: {{t0}} / team 1: {{t1}}
trumpNote: TRUMPS ARE NOT JUST THE TRUMP SUIT: every {{level}} in all four suits and all four jokers are trumps too. High to low: red joker > black joker > trump-suit level card > off-suit level cards > plain trumps.
pointsLine: THE DEFENDERS (team {{team}}) COLLECT THE POINTS. They hold {{points}}; {{target}} takes the deal (of {{total}} in the pack).
notDeclared: Nobody has declared yet. If everyone passes the hand is played with NO TRUMP SUIT.
noDeclarable: You hold no level card, so you cannot declare.
declarePrompt: d <0-4> to declare (0 passes; only a stronger showing overrides)
kittyPrompt: b <idx x{{count}}> to bury {{count}} cards. Keep your points and trumps out of the kitty: if the defenders take the last trick, the kitty's points reach them multiplied by (cards in the last trick x {{mult}})
promptHelp: p <idx...> to play (you must follow the led suit while you hold it)
handHeldLine: The declarers held ({{points}} of {{target}} to the defenders). Team {{team}} climbs {{advance}} level(s)
handTakenLine: The defenders collected {{points}} ({{target}} or more). The deal changes hands and team {{team}} climbs {{advance}} level(s)
kittyLine: kitty: {{points}} points (x{{mult}}) went to the defenders
handTaken: The defenders reached eighty and took the deal
result.cpuWin: Game over! The other team wins.
helpExampleDeclare: d 0                       pass on declaring a trump
